profile.summary: A private Christian university in Fresno, California, offering undergraduate, graduate, seminary and degree completion programs. It enrolls about 3,000 students across several locations and online, and offers teaching credential programs that include intern and student teaching pathways.

sources.title: Fresno Pacific University - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: Identity is plausible (Fresno Pacific University, EIN 94-1021164, CA teaching credential programs fit the K-12 intern MOU), and address, phone, website, EIN and org type are confirmed.
